data.long_meaning: Anmiya is a Sanskrit name for a female that represents the embodiment of love and desire. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu-miya', which means 'desirable'. In Hindu mythology, Anmiya is considered to be the goddess of love and desire. She is also known as 'Manmatha', the god of love.
